ideas.name: Fix-It Drawer Kit
ideas.concept: Compact precision driver set with magnetic screw tray and pre-printed spare-part/serial log cards in a flat box, aimed at first-time appliance repairers.
ideas.target_customer: Urban Nordic households 25-45 who want to repair small appliances and electronics
ideas.problem_solved: New repair rights create intent to repair but no accessible, well-designed starter kit; repair feels intimidating.
ideas.trend_evidence: EU Right to Repair Directive (2024/1799) applied from 31 July 2026 with an EU repair platform; BEUC criticism that repair stays costly suggests DIY demand. Retail demand for repair kits NOT verified by data.
ideas.defensibility_angle: Nordic design, QR-linked repair guides in SV/DA, product-category bundles; generic bits are copyable so brand and content carry it.
ideas.tooling_needed: None (custom printed box and tray insert only)

ideas.name: Spare Parts Cabinet Label System
ideas.concept: Stackable fabric/paper-board organiser with labelled pockets for manuals, receipts, spare parts and warranty data per appliance, with QR to repair info.
ideas.target_customer: Homeowners and renters with many appliances
ideas.problem_solved: Repair rights and spare-part availability only help if you keep model numbers, manuals and parts together.
ideas.trend_evidence: Right to Repair applies to listed product categories and depends on spare part availability; no direct sales evidence for such organisers found.
ideas.defensibility_angle: Design registration and companion appliance-database; building-industry angle (window, roof, ventilation parts logs).

ideas.name: Home Maintenance Spare Kit for Windows
ideas.concept: Branded pack of replacement window seals, hinge grease and gauge tools with a how-to for draught-proofing, from VELUX-type window know-how.
ideas.target_customer: Nordic homeowners with roof and standard windows
ideas.problem_solved: Draughts and condensation cost energy; owners lack correct maintenance parts and instructions.
ideas.trend_evidence: Repair-over-replace policy direction supports maintenance products; energy-saving demand not verified in this research. Verify before committing.
ideas.defensibility_angle: Founders' window domain expertise, step-by-step content and fit-guide per window type; supplier exclusivity on seals possible.
ideas.tooling_needed: None if stock EPDM profiles used

ideas.name: Refill-Ready Travel Bottle Set
ideas.concept: Durable travel toiletry bottles with a standardised wide-mouth refill system, colour-coded labels and bulk-refill compatibility, designed for reuse rather than single-use minis.
ideas.problem_solved: Single-use mini packaging is being targeted; users need a reuse-friendly, leak-proof set.
ideas.trend_evidence: PPWR (Reg. 2025/40) applies from 12 Aug 2026, with reuse targets (40% by 2030) and reusable packaging labelling later; the Commission distinguishes reusable from consumer-refillable packaging. Direct product demand not verified.
ideas.defensibility_angle: Design patent/registered design for the closure and label system; refill pouches create repeat purchase.
ideas.tooling_needed: Use existing catalog bottles; avoid new moulds

ideas.name: PFAS-Free Dry Packing Cubes
ideas.concept: Water-resistant packing cubes and pouches made from fabric certified PFAS-free for water repellency, marketed with test documentation.
ideas.problem_solved: PFAS restrictions on waterproofing in Denmark and France, and EU PFHxA limits, make PFAS-free claims a trust signal.
ideas.trend_evidence: Denmark restricts PFAS in clothing, footwear and waterproofing products from 1 July 2026; France since 1 Jan 2026; EU PFHxA restriction from 10 Oct 2026 (apparel and textiles). Luggage/cube scope not confirmed, so this is an inference.
ideas.defensibility_angle: Lab-test certificates and supplier exclusivity on PFAS-free coated fabric; Danish-market trust and design.

ideas.name: Appliance Care Refill Kit
ideas.concept: Subscription-style replacement kit (filters, belts, brushes) with a simple installation tool for popular household vacuum and small appliance models, using Nilfisk-style cleaning-tech sourcing contacts.
ideas.target_customer: Owners of mainstream robot and stick vacuums
ideas.problem_solved: Spare parts are expensive and hard to choose; the repair directive left pricing unregulated.
ideas.trend_evidence: Euronews/BEUC: spare parts priced far above reasonable (e.g. EUR 281 vacuum battery) and no price benchmark in the directive, suggesting a gap for affordable parts. Compatible-parts market is likely crowded; not verified.
ideas.defensibility_angle: Fit-guarantee database and bundles; weak IP, so brand and convenience are the moat. Verify IP and compatibility risks.
